Tour 3 Stunning New Construction Homes Near Temple, TX – Deer Grove Community. 

FREE GUIDE:
Home Buyer Guide (New Construction) 
→ https://bit.ly/4gaw6TI

Deer Grove is a growing new construction community located on the outskirts of Temple, Texas, within Bell County. It is known for its low property taxes, spacious half-acre lots, and homes currently priced between $500K - $600K, making it an attractive choice for homebuyers looking for affordability without compromising on space or quality.

One of the biggest advantages of living in Deer Grove is its strategic location between two major Texas cities:
📍 Austin, TX – Just 1 hour and 15 minutes away
📍 Waco, TX – Only 45 minutes away

Why Choose Deer Grove?
✅ Spacious Half-Acre Lots – More room for outdoor living
✅ Lower Property Taxes – Located outside Temple city limits
✅ Quick Access to Austin & Waco – Ideal for commuting and weekend trips
✅ High Home Value – Many homes are appraising for $100K+ more than their current selling price

🏡 Featured Homes in This Tour:
Bright Side Builders – 2,300 sq. ft, 4 Bed, 2.5 Bath ($537K)
Robinson Home – 2,457 sq. ft, 4 Bed, 2 Bath ($495K)
Circle G Construction – 2,700 sq. ft, 4 Bed, 3.5 Bath ($599K)

📢 Ready to Find Your Dream Home in Central Texas?
If you're considering buying a home in Temple, TX, or even if you're currently looking in Austin or Waco, Deer Grove offers an incredible opportunity to own a spacious, high-value home with lower property taxes and half-acre lots—all within a short drive to both cities!

Why limit your search to Austin TX or Waco TX when you can get more space, lower costs, and beautiful new construction homes just minutes away? Call or text today to schedule a private tour!
